evidence: The impurity content and binding structure of the films were analyzed by X-ray photoemission spectroscopy (XPS). The crystal structures were determined by a glancing-angle X-ray diffraction (XRD) with 1° angle of incident for all samples. Atomic force microscopy (AFM) was used to investigate the surface morphology and the surface roughness of the films. The contact angle of water on steel surface and photoinduced degradation of organic liquid as a function of UV exposure time were measured. Identiﬁcation and quantiﬁcation of 4-CP were performed by using high-performance liquid chromatography.
